{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.62

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns max load value of given uniform, vest or backpack container. For other types of containers, use [[maxLoad]] command

|s1= [[getContainerMaxLoad]] containerClass

|p1= containerClass: [[String]] - uniform, vest or backpack class

|r1= [[Number]] - load value, -1 if not available.

|x1= <sqf>
private _maxLoadUniform		= getContainerMaxLoad uniform player;
private _maxLoadVest		= getContainerMaxLoad vest player;
private _maxLoadBackpack	= getContainerMaxLoad backpack player;
</sqf>
